modification_description: Replace 'veto power' with meaningful influence and shared authority that has guardrails against indefinite blocking. Specifically: (1) establish a time-limited structured discernment process with a worship-change task force and clear timelines (8–12 weeks of listening plus 2–3 planning cycles); (2) give traditional members meaningful influence over pace, character, and which elements change, but use a transparent decision rule (supermajority vote or minimum consensus threshold) rather than unlimited veto; (3) identify non-negotiable worship elements tied to spiritual formation and keep those stable while piloting contemporary elements in limited formats (e.g., one service per month or blended format) to build trust incrementally.
